div.div: On HA failover: PAN-OS on FW2 calls EC2 API (via IAM role) to (1) move the Floating EIP from FW1 untrust ENI to FW2 untrust ENI, and (2) update the trust route table next-hop to FW2's trust ENI. ~30–60 seconds. HA1 (TCP 28769): heartbeat via management interface — no dedicated ENI. HA2 (IP proto 99 or UDP 29281): bulk session sync via eth1/1.
